brief_rationale: The doctor handled the major hypertension risk well: obtained standardized repeat BP values, screened red flags, advised same-day local evaluation for persistent systolic ≥180, avoided self-adjustment of antihypertensives, and repaired medication/follow-up handoffs. However, RC5 was only partially met because the doctor confirmed levofloxacin and no eye rubbing but did not carry forward the authored eye-care duties to avoid dirty water entering the eye and early strenuous activity. Under the frozen rubric, this minor responsibility-chain omission caps the trajectory at Borderline despite multiple high-order strengths.
